Move: Catch UsIf You Can!
When the user’s move targeting an allied sync pair (excluding field effects) is successful, restores the HP of the allied sync pair affected by the move by approximately 20% of its maximum HP.

tile_desc_5100038000: The user also takes 25% of the damage it dealt to the target.
tile_desc_5100045000: Lowers the target’s Attack by one stat .

tile_desc_5100189000: Lowers the target’s accuracy by one stat .
tile_desc_5100202000: The more damage dealt to the target, the more it restores the user’s HP.
tile_desc_5100204000: Lowers the target’s Attack by two stat .
tile_desc_5100241000: Attacks the target two to five times in a row.
